changes: The seven execution-plane subissues of #56 are implemented and merged into main: solver decision projection, credential verification persistence, fresh demo catalogs, structured exploration/profile workflow results, solver-derived no-match roadmaps, structured match/training workflow results, and evaluation documentation.
The parent acceptance criteria are covered by the merged subissue implementations and their regression tests; no duplicate functional changes were required on the parent branch.

skipped: The unconstrained npm test run is not a clean completion signal in this environment: two pre-existing PDF/OCR tests and one training beforeAll intermittently exceed Vitest timeouts under the full parallel suite. The same gate:ci run passed 635 tests with 8 skipped.
validation.notes: Focused execution-plane tests pass (42 tests). Typecheck passes. gate:ci passes with 635 tests, 8 skipped, and 92.6% line coverage.

riskRemaining: The full non-coverage test command remains sensitive to environment-dependent timeout behavior in unrelated PDF/OCR and training setup tests; publication should use the passing gate:ci result and retain this note.
